candidates.decision_relevance: Would allow the analyses to reconstruct intraperiod price paths and compare them with freeze-time observations, rather than relying on weekly endpoints or qualitative path descriptions. This would materially improve assessment of sequence, rebound magnitude, and candidate-range containment.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews W34–W46 repeatedly lack raw price paths, forecast bounds, and timestamped signal sequences; daily reviews also report horizon disagreement and point-in-time cutoffs.
candidates.metric_name: BTC and ETH hourly prices with timestamped, freeze-aligned candidate specifications and bounds
candidates.missing_history_problem: Without the historical path and the candidate specification as frozen at issuance, endpoint summaries cannot show whether a rebound or drawdown preceded a warning, whether evidence was available at the stated cutoff, or whether a range was precise rather than merely broad.

candidates.decision_relevance: A consistent historical breadth series would help distinguish persistent participation changes from isolated proxy snapshots and assess whether breadth deterioration or recovery preceded price moves.
candidates.evidence_reference: Multiple daily and weekly reviews describe breadth as proxy-only, with changing point-in-time membership, missing methodology, or no historical sequence; W45–W46 specifically lack breadth measurements needed to test competing explanations.
candidates.metric_name: Point-in-time cross-sectional breadth counts or advance ratio with universe and membership timestamp
candidates.missing_history_problem: Sparse snapshots from changing universes cannot establish persistence, comparable changes, or the timing of breadth relative to price paths.

candidates.decision_relevance: A dated sequence would show whether reported settled-flow divergence persisted, reversed, or was limited to a single session, improving temporal comparison with price and breadth observations.
candidates.evidence_reference: Several daily reviews have only one supplied settled session; W44–W46 reviews explicitly note absent current-week flow rows or stale flow detail.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF flow totals with settlement dates and reported units
candidates.missing_history_problem: Single-session or stale totals cannot establish flow persistence or align flow changes with the reviewed weekly price sequence.

candidates.decision_relevance: Candidate-linked matured outcomes would make the repeated calibration discussion auditable at the claim and horizon level, without treating overlapping freezes as independent events.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews report matured-outcome counts but lack scorecard rows, candidate-level results, or independent-event counts; earlier reviews also note absent eligible typed warning outcomes.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen candidate specifications linked to maturity-dated realized outcomes and source freeze identifiers
candidates.missing_history_problem: Aggregate counts and cohort summaries do not permit verification of candidate-level errors, range outcomes, maturity status, or overlap among observations.
